title_en: Refuting the Theory of Attributing a Limit to God (Episode 6)
description_en: Refuting the Theory of Attributing a Limit to God (Episode 6), from the program Al-Tawhid by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV.
summary: This lecture presents a scholarly critique of the theological view that ascribes physical limits or boundaries to God.
